notes.title: PvP Playtest with the Developers
notes.content:
We're excited to announce a special event happening this [b]Friday, July 28th, from 4pm to 5:30pm CEST.[/b] Join us for an exclusive opportunity to play with the developers of Nitro Nation VR on Steam!

That's right, you'll get to hang out and play with the folks who made the game, ask them whatever you want, and share your thoughts on the game.

If you want to join in on the fun, make sure to swing by our [url=https://discord.gg/v8RybDxsuV]Discord server[/url] where you can find all the deets you need to participate!

Mark your calendars for [b]Friday, July 28th[/b], and we'll see you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589097/37089983f5d7f6843b6a35e0ec40d1ca18326bbd.gif[/img]

[h3]Event Details:[/h3]
[b]Date:[/b] Friday, July 28th
[b]Time:[/b] 4pm to 5:30pm CEST
[b]Location:[/b] Nitro Nation VR Demo on Steam
[b]Platform for communication:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/v8RybDxsuV]https://discord.gg/v8RybDxsuV[/url]

Can't wait to see you there!

notes.title: Steam Racing Fest 2022
notes.content:
Hello, fellow racers!

We are glad to announce an update, as we are now participating in Steam Racing Fest 2022.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589097/7a4900cb67ab9473943b9fb87d7c5d425c7c86a4.gif[/img]

Here are a few new things that you can try out since the last update in February 2022:
[list]
[*] There's now a functional gearbox for switching gears
[*] Automatic gas is now manual, use the right trigger button on your controller
[/list]
We also want to remind you that [b]we have our own re-centering system[/b] and [b]you can easily re-center with the left stick push[/b] while in-game.

We are continuing to work hard on many new things that will come in the future.

We would love to hear from you what you think about the new features listed above and the game overall. 

Put the pedal to the metal and see you on the track, racers!
